description: Removes an existing subscription to notifications; may also remove shared data change subscriptions if the Shared-Data-retrieval feature is supported.

constraints.statement: The NF Service Consumer shall send a DELETE request to the resource URI representing the individual subscription.
evidence: "The NF Service Consumer shall send a DELETE request to the resource URI representing the individual subscription."
constraints.why_interesting: This defines the required HTTP method and target resource for unsubscribe.

constraints.statement: The DELETE request body shall be empty.
constraints.why_interesting: This is an observable request payload constraint.

constraints.statement: On success, the NRF shall return 204 No Content.
evidence: "On success, \"204 No Content\" shall be returned."
constraints.why_interesting: This is the required success status code.

constraints.statement: On success, the response body shall be empty.
constraints.why_interesting: This is an observable response payload constraint.

constraints.statement: If the subscription identified by subscriptionID is not found in the NRF's list of active subscriptions, the NRF shall return 404 Not Found.
evidence: "If the subscription, identified by the \"subscriptionID\", is not found in the list of active subscriptions in the NRF's database, the NRF shall return \"404 Not Found\" status code with the ProblemDetails IE providing details of the error."
constraints.why_interesting: This defines the required error status for a missing subscription.

constraints.statement: If the subscription identified by subscriptionID is not found, the response shall include ProblemDetails providing details of the error.
evidence: "...with the ProblemDetails IE providing details of the error."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required error payload element for the not-found case.

constraints.statement: In case of redirection, the NRF shall return a 3xx status code.
evidence: "In the case of redirection, the NRF shall return 3xx status code..."
constraints.why_interesting: This constrains the redirect response class.

constraints.statement: In case of redirection, the NRF response shall contain a Location header.
evidence: "...which shall contain a Location header with an URI pointing to the endpoint of another NRF service instance."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a testable header requirement for redirects.

constraints.statement: In case of redirection, the Location header URI shall point to the endpoint of another NRF service instance.
evidence: "...with an URI pointing to the endpoint of another NRF service instance."
constraints.why_interesting: This specifies the semantic destination of the redirect.

constraints.statement: For subscription removal in a different PLMN, the DELETE request sent to the NRF in the Serving PLMN shall include the identity of the home PLMN or SNPN as component values of subscriptionID.
evidence: "this request shall include the identity of the PLMN or SNPN of the home NRF (MCC/MNC/NID values) as component values of the subscriptionID"
constraints.why_interesting: This is a cross-PLMN request-format requirement.

constraints.statement: For subscription removal in a different PLMN, the subscriptionID sent to the NRF in the Home PLMN shall not contain the identity of the PLMN.
evidence: "the subscriptionID sent to the NRF in the Home PLMN shall not contain the identity of the PLMN"
constraints.why_interesting: This is a specific forwarding constraint that can be checked by inspecting the forwarded request.

constraints.statement: For subscription removal in a different PLMN, the subscriptionID sent to the NRF in the Home PLMN shall be the same subscriptionID value as originally generated by the NRF in the Home PLMN.
evidence: "it shall be the same subscriptionID value as originally generated by the NRF in the Home PLMN"
constraints.why_interesting: This constrains the exact identifier value used in home-PLMN deletion.

constraints.statement: If the subscription was created in a different NRF in the HPLMN than the NRF in the HPLMN that receives the delete request, the latter shall forward the request toward the NRF in the HPLMN holding the subscription.
evidence: "the latter shall forward the request received from the NRF in the serving PLMN towards the NRF in the HPLMN holding the subscription"
constraints.why_interesting: This defines mandatory forwarding behavior across NRF instances.

constraints.statement: The status code returned to the NF Service Consumer in the Serving PLMN shall be in accordance with the result received from the NRF in the Home PLMN.
evidence: "a status code is returned from the NRF in serving PLMN to the NF Service Consumer in Serving PLMN in accordance to the result received from NRF in Home PLMN."
constraints.why_interesting: This constrains response propagation across PLMN boundaries.
